name: Black Glass Studio
summary: Floating slabs of black glossy glass whose screens glow like a real app; a small toy hero hops across them and every press visibly builds a glowing title card, then the panels power down and fall away.

palette.use: the set: a near-black void the panels float in (proposed)
black glossy glass: the slabs' faces (proposed)
UI labels and the title card's type (proposed)
UI hairlines, track lanes, inactive bars (proposed)
the hero toy and the glow of what it builds: the title card's key word, spark rays (proposed)
screen light: active buttons, keyframes, the playhead, wires, selections (proposed)

type.emphasis: the key word of the title card in the hero colour with a glow and spark rays

banned: real logos, real app names or a real mascot: the hero is an invented toy shape and the app is generic
a press that doesn't change anything visible
white light blocks reflected on the glass: lights are hidden from glossy rays
cropping a 16:9 film for vertical: vertical is its own composition with bigger type and fewer panels
washed-out hero colour (AgX lightens colours: lower the exposure and darken the base colour, then measure)
vague fixes: every change is a number
AI video models or hand-keyed animation: every frame comes from code and one timeline file

sources.what: Claude + Blender: Make 3D Motion Graphics From Code (guide, 7 pp)
